text: What is wrong with SNMPv2c in a modern network?
choices: Authentication is a community string sent in cleartext, so anyone who can capture a packet can read your inventory and, if it is read-write, reconfigure your equipment
explanation: The default strings are public and private and remain in use on production equipment with dispiriting frequency. v3 adds authentication and encryption; the reason it is often not used is that it is more work to configure, which is not a good reason.
